# The gauntlet (generated by sim/gauntlet.py)

100 runs per party and leg. Fodder 3, then Fodder 3 + 2 Regulars, then Elite 4, then a camp (everyone Rests: 2/3 of HP and MP, Wounded heals; D9), then Boss 4; otherwise nothing restored (HP, MP, the pouch, Wounded and the dead carry); rooms are mirrored (reach slots, Nov 23). The AI plays: a floor. *Brings* is the HP (and MP) the party walks in with, as a share of its full pools; *falls* counts heroes downed in that room (a won room stands them up at 1 HP, Wounded).
